name: League of Women Voters Education Fund
summary: The 501(c)(3) arm of the League of Women Voters, the nonpartisan US civic organisation founded in 1920 (the League of Women Voters of the United States itself is a 501(c)(4), and gifts to it aren't tax-deductible). With more than 700 state and local Leagues, the Education Fund runs VOTE411.org, the League's voter guide, registers voters, holds candidate forums and debates, brings voting-rights lawsuits with donated counsel, and campaigns for fair maps, voting access and other reforms. In the year to June 2025 it spent $11.3 million of its own money, beside $5.4 million of donated legal services and advertising.
